answer:
I added a page to your Reading log. It has three parts:

- **Stats:** total books read, average rating (currently 4.2 ★) and your best month.
- **Books per month:** a bar chart that includes months with no books.
- **Shelf:** cover-style cards, newest first. Each card has a generated colour cover with the title and author, plus a star rating and the finish date.

The page reads straight from your table, so new rows show up on their own. The table and the rest of the note are unchanged. You can see the page under the Page switch in the note.

The covers are generated colours, not real book art, since the page can't load images.
